name: milpa/app-runtime
description: The agent runtime a Milpa app INSTALLS instead of copying: session gate, sub-agent delegation, tree budget, sterile-loop guard and the live bridge. Lives here so an existing app receives its improvements — a template that copies what nobody edits is a package in disguise.

suggest.milpa/agent: The agent runtime itself: sessions, gates, sub-agents. Without it the agent operations are not offered.
suggest.milpa/ai-gateway: One message and tool-call shape across model providers. Needed by the agent operations.
suggest.milpa/auth: Verifying the token a caller presents over HTTP.
suggest.milpa/event-store: Append-only session streams. Needed by the agent operations.
suggest.milpa/live-web: Mounts the live wire (LivePlugin): server-rendered components take actions over HTTP with signed state, CSRF and replay protection — dashboards, admin panels.
